pages.text: A busy farm is a noisy farm: humming drones, bubbling extraction chambers, crackling generators and the mobs locked inside them. Place a $(l)Muffler$() and the sounds you choose go quiet within $(l)10 blocks$().
A weight bobs on its coil as it works: the more kinds of sound you silence, the faster it goes, and it rests when it silences none.

$(l)Right-click$() the Muffler and flip the switch of each kind of sound. A new Muffler silences everything.$(br)$(li)$(l)Machines$(): CyberFarm machines: generators, the Drone Assembler, the Methane Extractor
pages.title: Choosing what it silences

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Drones$(): the whine of their rotors (it fades out as a drone flies into range), takeoff and landing$(br)$(li)$(l)Monsters$(): hostile mobs, like the zombie in your Methane Extractor$(br)$(li)$(l)Animals$(): passive and neutral mobs: cows, chickens, villagers...
$(li)$(l)Other machines$(): the sounds listed in the client config: by default furnaces, blast furnaces and smokers

Each Muffler keeps its own choices, so one can quiet the drone field while another keeps the mob farm silent. Your own sounds are never touched: footsteps, doors, tools, blocks you place or break, music and other players.
In $(l)Mods → CyberFarm → Config$() (or config/cyberfarm-client.toml):$(br)$(li)$(l)Range$(): distance in blocks every Muffler covers, 1 to 64 (default 10);
pages.title: Client config

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Extra Sounds to Mute$(): what the $(l)Other machines$() row silences. Add a mod id (mekanism) for all of a mod's sounds, or a single sound id (minecraft:block.furnace.fire_crackle).
The Muffler needs no power. Use several to cover a large base.
